status: Fixed; reproduced before and desktop-verified after
cause: Videos drawer global pointerdown and keydown handlers acted on events inside native dialogs mounted through a portal. Internal heading/label/blank-area clicks closed the drawer and unmounted its Team modal. Number-field ArrowDown selected the next background project and also unmounted the modal.

steps: Open LOOM project details > Team > Assign Shooter
Click the Assign team member heading
beforeReproduction.observed: Both the assignment dialog and underlying project drawer disappear.

steps: Reopen the LOOM Team assignment dialog
beforeReproduction.observed: Assignment dialog disappears and background drawer switches to Customer Story - APAC Hiring.

fix: Ignore Videos drawer dismissal/navigation handlers while a native dialog is open. Native dialog controls retain ownership of their own dismissal and keyboard behaviour. No DS changes.
checks: At 1440 and 1133, changing hours then clicking the heading, labels or other non-control content keeps the dialog and correct background project open
Role options disclosure opens without dismissing its parent
Hours ArrowUp changes 10 to 10.25 and calculated rate to $1,601.56; ArrowDown returns to 10, without changing the project
Project-rate ArrowUp changes only the draft rate, from $1,400 to $1,401
Tab arrow navigation stays within the dialog
Nested invitation confirmation heading clicks leave both dialogs open; cancelling leaves outer draft intact
Cancel closes the editor, preserves the project drawer and restores focus to Assign Shooter
A genuine outside click closes the drawer normally when no dialog is open
Direct Videos entry remains open after internal heading click and number-field ArrowDown; Escape closes it normally
notPerformed: No final assignment, invitation send, withdrawal, removal or Save hours action
Native backdrop dismissal policy left unchanged; its separate outside-boundary pointer path was source reviewed rather than directly exercised
No tests, build, dependency install, commit or push

dataPreservation.initialisationNote: Existing mock media preparation advanced automatically and onboarding.reviewDraft populated during initial startup. Exact changes are retained in setup-record-differences.json; they were not caused by assignment actions. Business state excluding that onboarding draft, offers and Studio settings were unchanged throughout.

crop.classification: Pixel crop of a genuine current-application screenshot after the fix. Full source retained.
